decision_reason: G8 IndexKeyConstruction abort-on-Err invariant requires the Verus WEAK_EXTERN mirror update. PS-008 production mirror at L78-95 enumerates 7 guards; adding G8 requires a new match arm in assume_specification, new index_key_ok:bool exec arg, new exec wrapper wrapper_append_event_index_key_error. Production-binding gate is mandatory per AGENTS.md. The mirror MUST be regenerated and re-verified via bash scripts/verify-verus.sh, bash scripts/check-verus-production-binding.sh, and bash scripts/check-production-inner-drift.sh.

Proptest variant hammers the G8 path with arbitrary ActionId/RunId/StepIdx triples and asserts the abort invariant under all inputs. Property: after Err(KeyCapacity) from G8, is_aborted() == true and commit() returns Err(BatchAborted). Extends crates/vb_storage/tests/proptest_vb_vzcuf_PS_004.rs or new file proptest_vb_hyog0_PS_010.rs.

Guard Precedence (C6) requires the 8-guard order G1..G8 to be proved from the assume_specification contract's per-variant witness preconditions. PS-008 spec file's lemma_guard_order_is_valid must be extended to include G8 < Ok(()) and G7 < G8 pair-wise orderings. The Guard enum at vb-vzcuf-PS-008.rs:237-245 gains IndexKeyConstruction variant.

Regression test batch_append_event_index_key_error_aborts_commit in crates/vb_storage/src/batch/t_append_event.rs mirrors batch_index_key_error_aborts_commit at t_putters_b.rs:177-209. Asserts: (1) append_event returns Err(JournalError::KeyCapacity), (2) batch.is_aborted() == true, (3) batch.commit() returns Err(JournalError::BatchAborted), (4) events_for_run(run).is_empty(). The reference pattern at t_putters_b.rs:177-209 is the canonical template.

Master §49 Crash-Consistency Rule integration test using a real Fjall database instance. After G8 KeyCapacity fires and the batch is aborted, no journal event and no index_action mutation are durable for the run. Asserts events_for_run(run).is_empty() and no pending-action-index entries exist for the action. This is the END-TO-END proof that the abort-on-Err pattern correctly prevents master §49 violation.

Production mirrors at verification/verus/production_inner/vb_vzcuf_PS_008_production.rs:78-95 and _PS_009_production.rs:67-93 enumerate 7 guards and declare KeyCapacity as unreachable (PS-008 L174, PS-009 L168-171). With G8 added, KeyCapacity becomes reachable from stage_pending_action_index_op. Mirrors MUST be regenerated to match production. Drift-gate header at PS-008 L5-14 and PS-009 L5-32 explicitly requires regeneration. Production-binding gate (scripts/check-verus-production-binding.sh) is mandatory.

The G8 path is exercised in the regression test batch_append_event_index_key_error_aborts_commit. The defensive KeyCapacity is unreachable under nominal ActionId/RunId/StepIdx inputs (workflow-model.md#KeyCapacity-reachability), so the test must use controlled scenario per boundary-map.md#test-boundary option A/B/C. The proof-writer will choose the trigger mechanism; this decision is documented as an open domain question in contract.md#open-domain-questions.

Proptest variant hammers G8 with arbitrary ActionId/RunId/StepIdx triples via kani::any-style arbitrary construction in crates/vb_storage/tests/proptest_vb_hyog0_PS_010.rs (or extension to proptest_vb_vzcuf_PS_004.rs). Asserts abort invariant under all reachable inputs plus the defensive KeyCapacity path. Property: arbitrary triple -> Err(KeyCapacity) path -> batch.is_aborted() == true && batch.commit() == Err(BatchAborted).

Public API surface review: pub fn append_event(&mut self, event: &JournalEvent) -> Result<(), JournalError> signature unchanged; pub fn is_aborted(&self) -> bool accessor unchanged; pub fn commit(self) -> Result<(), JournalError> signature unchanged; JournalError::KeyCapacity variant unchanged (no new variant introduced). The post-condition gains a new clause; documented but does not widen the type surface. api-surface-check is non-behavior-affecting.

Documentation-only change to append_event.rs:18-26 (Guard Precedence) and L33-41 (Postconditions). The doc-comment update is documentation-review; the behavior claim is borne by PS-001 (verus) and PS-002 (regression test). Doc-comment review is not a proof-bearing lane; the proof is the behavior change observed in the regression test.

Existing Kani harness at crates/vb_storage/src/kani_vb_vzcuf_ps004.rs already covers G3 durable-duplicate abort path. Adding a parallel Kani harness for G8 would require duplicating the SpecJournalWriteBatch mirror with the new index_key_ok:bool argument. The Verus WEAK_EXTERN mirror update (PS-001/PS-003/PS-008) is strictly stronger: it binds to production via assume_specification and proves the guard-ordering property from the contract's per-variant witness preconditions. A separate Kani harness would add maintenance cost without strengthening the proof.

No refinement types in the batch layer. The Verus mirror's assume_specification already provides refinement-style post-conditions per guard (SpecJournalWriteBatch state predicates in spec_state_preserved and spec_state_preserved_except_aborted). Flux would add redundant coverage.
non_applicability_evidence_refs: boundary-map.md#verifier-boundary — Verus mirror is primary refinement mechanism

decision_reason: JournalWriteBatch is !Send + !Sync via PhantomData<*mut FjallJournal> (types.rs:18-21). Single-threaded; no cross-thread aliasing possible. The queued-writer path's OwnedWriteBatch is also single-shot (queue/writer/stage.rs:31-74). No loom or scheduling proof required.
All source files in scope carry #![forbid(unsafe_code)]. Zero unsafe blocks, no FFI, no raw pointers, no MaybeUninit, no provenance-sensitive operations. Safe Rust only.

G8 fix is a 1-line replacement of ? with map_err. No parser, no codec, no hostile byte boundary at this layer. Defensive KeyCapacity unreachable under nominal ActionId/RunId/StepIdx triples. Fuzzing would not strengthen the proof; the proptest with arbitrary triples (PS-005) provides sufficient input-space coverage.

TLA+ lane removed from this skill. The temporal/state-machine behavior of JournalWriteBatch is a single-threaded append_event state machine (workflow-model.md#typestates Open -> Aborted -> TerminalNoOp) with no concurrent state transitions. The proptest with arbitrary triples (PS-005) plus the regression test (PS-002) cover the temporal transitions. No loom model is necessary (PhantomData<*mut FjallJournal>).
